description: This Python module dynamically generates SDK functions for container operations based on a JSON configuration, utilizing a generic container handler and supporting both synchronous and asynchronous calls.

methods.name: _load_endpoints_config
methods.description: Loads the endpoints configuration from a JSON file.

methods.name: create_sync_endpoint_function
methods.description: Creates a synchronous SDK function for a specific endpoint based on its configuration.

methods.name: create_async_endpoint_function
methods.description: Wraps a sync function into an asynchronous SDK function.

methods.name: generate_container_endpoints
methods.description: Generates all container endpoint functions from the JSON configuration.

methods.name: get_all_endpoint_names
methods.description: Returns a list of all endpoint names (sync and async).

methods.name: get_async_endpoint_names
methods.description: Returns a list of all async endpoint names.
